This '''starship''' belonged to the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|hunter]] [[Crovan Dane]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] and was used to transport creatures to the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Akoshissss]] for use in [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Cyberneticist/Legends|cyberneticist]] [[Bitt Panith]]'s experiments.
